independence.uses: fresh raw OANDA Practice EUR_USD M5 bid/ask only

neuralNetwork.architecture: frozen V7 26->16->1 opportunity classifier plus one conditional 36->24->1 direction classifier

labels.opportunity: either executable long or short reaches +1.5R before -0.75R within 60 minutes
labels.direction: trained only where exactly one side reaches the target; predicts whether that target side is long

neuralNetwork.selection: frozen V7 opportunity score plus nine causal direction mechanisms calibrated only on 2024 after training on 2022-2023

execution.disabledReason: no 2024 tier at 2-3 trades/day achieved >=40% target-path precision, >=40% wins, positive expectancy, and PF >1 with at least 600 trades
execution.signalFrequency: evaluated after every completed M5 candle; Stage 1 predicts target-path opportunity, Stage 2 selects direction, otherwise WAIT
execution.thresholdSelection: 2024-only calibration frontier; highest-expectancy qualifying 2-3 trades/day tier locked before 2025

gates.development2025: n>=600, 2-3 trades/day, win rate>=40%, expectancy>0, PF>1, better-path accuracy>50.5%
